summary: Full regression of NEW admin features (JWT auth, dashboard, manual booking, stats, notifications stub). Backend: 21/21 pytest tests pass. Frontend: end-to-end UI flow (login redirect, bad creds, good creds, stats render, manual booking dialog, row actions Paid/Done, tabs, refresh, logout token clear, /admin re-auth) all work. One minor UX issue on sign-out destination.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking Sign out, user is taken to /login (with a 'Signed out.' toast) instead of the public home '/'. Cause: logout() clears user state -> RequireAdmin re-renders and <Navigate to="/login"> fires before the explicit navigate("/") call resolves. Spec asked for redirect to /. Token IS properly cleared from localStorage and /admin correctly bounces back to /login on a subsequent visit, so the protection itself works.

issues: Radix Dialog warns: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined}' — add a <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to <DialogContent> for accessibility.

action_items: (Optional/Low) Fix sign-out destination in /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx -> call logout() AFTER navigate('/'), e.g. navigate('/', {replace:true}); setTimeout(logout,0); — or just accept landing on /login.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription to manual booking <DialogContent> to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/admin_auth.py uses hmac.compare_digest against the RAW env password (not a bcrypt hash). The `import bcrypt` and trailing `_ = bcrypt` are dead weight — drop the dependency or actually hash the env password and store the bcrypt digest. Today the credential lives in plaintext in /app/backend/.env.

/app/backend/server.py admin_login returns lowercase email but does not include `expires_in` / token TTL in the response — frontend has no way to proactively refresh. Acceptable given 12h TTL and `/admin/me` verification on load.

CORS is set to allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' (env default). When credentials=true, browsers reject wildcard origins. Today the admin auth uses bearer tokens (not cookies), so this is fine, but the config is contradictory — either set explicit origin(s) or set allow_credentials=False.
/app/backend/server.py: GET /api/bookings and GET /api/contact are now correctly gated by require_admin (fixing the PII leak flagged in iteration_1).

/app/backend/server.py: admin_create_manual_booking ignores payload.payment_status when constructing Booking (it is passed) but then ALWAYS sets status='upcoming' regardless of consultation_date. If admin enters a past date, booking is still labelled 'upcoming' on the doc — but UI computes upcoming/past from date, so harmless.
/app/backend/notifications.py correctly logs '[MOCK EMAIL]' / '[MOCK WHATSAPP]' when keys are empty and never raises — confirmed via TestPublicBookingWithStubbedNotify.

rca of the issue: Sign-out redirect: AuthContext.logout() synchronously sets user=null. React schedules re-render of <RequireAdmin>, which sees user=null and renders <Navigate to='/login'>. This client-side Navigate executes before / instead of the imperative navigate('/') from Admin.jsx because Admin is unmounted by the Navigate. Fix: in Admin.doLogout, call navigate('/') first, then logout(); or call logout() inside setTimeout(()=>logout(),0). Strictly a UX nit — auth state is correctly purged.
